hook: Most budgeting apps charge full price ever before you even test them.

sections.voiceover: Most budgeting apps charge full price ever before you even test them.
CNBC Select reviewed over two dozen budgeting apps to check costs. Investopedia named You Need a Budget the best overall app. Where did Quicken Simplifi land in the pricing review?
b_roll: A graphic showing zero based budgeting
A question mark over a price tag

sections.voiceover: Quicken Simplifi costs $3.49 per month for the first year, but that price jumps later.
b_roll: A price tag showing promotional rates

sections.voiceover: Quartz reported that CNBC Select found three standout budgeting apps built on different mechanisms. That introductory rate is a 50 percent discount before rising to $6.99 per month billed annually.
b_roll: Three app icons on a screen

sections.voiceover: Test your budget with a 7 day free trial.
